title: Graph Construction and Matching for Imperative Programs using Neural and Structural Methods
abstract: arXiv:2604.26578v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reusing verification artefacts requires identifying structural and semantic similarities across programs and their specifications. In this paper, we focus on graph construction as a foundational step toward this goal. We present a pipeline that converts imperative programs and their annotations into typed, attributed graphs. Our experiments cover datasets including C with ACSL, Java with JML, and Dafny programs. The pipeline integrates abstract syntax tree parsing with semantic embeddings derived from models such as SentenceTransformer and CodeBERT. This enables the generation of graph representations that capture both structural relationships and semantic context. Our results show that consistent graph representations can be constructed across different languages and annotation styles. This work provides a practical basis for future steps in semantic enrichment and approximate graph matching for scalable verification artefact

translated_title: 基于神经与结构方法的命令式程序图构建与匹配
translated_abstract: 复用验证产物需要识别程序及其规约之间的结构与语义相似性。在本文中，我们将图构建作为实现这一目标的基础步骤。我们提出了一条流水线，可将命令式程序及其标注转换为带类型的属性图。我们的实验涵盖多个数据集，包括带ACSL标注的C语言程序、带JML标注的Java程序以及Dafny程序。该流水线将抽象语法树解析与来自SentenceTransformer和CodeBERT等模型的语义嵌入相结合，从而能够生成同时捕捉结构关系和语义上下文的图表示。我们的结果表明，可以在不同语言和标注风格之间构建一致的图表示。这项工作为未来的语义增强和近似图匹配以实现可扩展的验证产物复用提供了实用基础。
tldr: 该论文提出一条将命令式程序及其标注转换为带类型属性图的流水线，通过结合抽象语法树解析与SentenceTransformer、CodeBERT等模型的语义嵌入，在C/ACSL、Java/JML和Dafny等多种语言上实现了跨语言、跨标注风格的一致性图表示，为验证产物复用和近似图匹配奠定了实用基础。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a pipeline that converts imperative programs and their annotations into typed, attributed graphs by integrating AST parsing with semantic embeddings from SentenceTransformer and CodeBERT, achieving consistent graph representations across C/ACSL, Java/JML, and Dafny programs as a practical foundation for verification artifact reuse and approximate graph matching.
